invariants.point_of_view: Close third person, one viewpoint per scene
invariants.narrative_distance: Close, with brief pull-backs at scene ends

clause_architecture.measurement: Mostly one or two clauses per sentence
clause_architecture.pattern: Main clause first, detail added after a comma
clause_architecture.example: She left early, before the rain.

paragraph_density.example: He waited. The gate stayed shut.

punctuation_texture.measurement: Periods and commas dominate; rare dashes
punctuation_texture.pattern: One dash per scene at most

concreteness.measurement: Most sentences name an object or a sensation
concreteness.pattern: Anchor every feeling in a thing

verb_energy.measurement: Action verbs in scenes, state verbs in reflection

modifier_frequency.pattern: One precise modifier, never a stack

intentional_repetition.measurement: Two motif words recur in every chapter
intentional_repetition.pattern: Echo an opening image at the close

sentence_openers.measurement: Half of sentences open with the subject
sentence_openers.pattern: Vary with a fronted time phrase
sentence_openers.example: By noon, the nets were dry.

transitions_connectors.example: The gull cried. She looked up.

figurative_density.measurement: About two figures per thousand words
figurative_density.pattern: Brief similes from work and weather

dialogue_rendering.measurement: Voices differ by word choice, not dialect
dialogue_rendering.pattern: Each speaker has one verbal habit

signature_moves.name: The flat close
signature_moves.template: End a scene on one concrete object.

signature_moves.name: Delayed name
signature_moves.template: Describe a person before naming them.
signature_moves.example: The tall one, the one with the limp, was Ada.

anti_patterns: Explaining a joke after it lands.
style_directives: Default to 10-18 word sentences, with a short one after each long one.
Ground every emotion in a physical detail within the same paragraph.
Use 'said' or an action beat for dialogue attribution.
Keep similes short and drawn from work or weather.
condensed_profile: Close third-person past narration with plain diction, short paragraphs and concrete detail. Feeling is shown through objects and gesture, transitions are implicit, and scenes end on a flat, physical image.
